name: Seal the Void
description: Collect Void Essence for Asterwatch's protective wards.

dialogue.offer: Our wards are failing. Four sealed traces of Void Essence would let me renew them.
dialogue.in_progress: The Reavers beyond the basin are dangerous, but their essence is exactly what the wards require.
dialogue.ready: The seals held. Quickly, place the vessels inside the warding circle.
dialogue.completed: Asterwatch is protected from the void once more.
